newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai March car sales dip 10 pct yr/yr - Toyota.
newsitem.headline: Thai March car sales dip 10 pct yr/yr - Toyota.

text.p: Sales of passenger cars and commercial vehicles in Thailand fell 10 percent in March to 48,072 units from 53,522 in the same month last year, Toyota Motors (Thailand) said on Thursday.
Cumulative vehicle sales in the first three months were down nine percent to 129,766 from 142,394 in the year-ago period, Toyota said in a statement.
Toyota Motor Corp remained the top seller of vehicles in the month with a 31.4 percent market share on sales of 15,108 against 14,717 in the same month in the previous year, it said.
Isuzu Motors Ltd came second with 11,060 cars sold in March, representing 23 percent market share, compared with 11,585 in the same month a year ago.
Toyota passenger car sales in the month were up 57.4 percent to 7,596 from 4,826. It was the top passenger car seller with 44.2 percent share in March.
Honda Motor Co Ltd was second with 3,812 units sold in the month, or 22.2 percent of passenger car market, against 3,109 in the same month last year, it said.
